title: Zaman tare
description: Ten short stories about living together: neighbours in Zaria who stop rain from eating their road, a Katsina town welcoming its emir home from the pilgrimage, a Kano family man rescued from poverty by his neighbours, a football final between two Bauchi neighbourhoods, a Christian and a Muslim friend sharing Christmas in Jos, a plot to take over a Kaduna traders' association, a farmer and a Fulani herder settling the damage to a sugarcane farm near Gombe, a Sokoto woman who cares for a sick almajiri, a retired colonel's neighbourhood watch in Kaduna, and a school debate in Abuja on whether modern technology divides society.

lessons.title: Hanyar da ruwa ya cinye
lessons.summary: In a Zaria neighbourhood, rain erodes the road to the market and makes it slippery; the district head Alhaji Abdulmumini calls the neighbours, warns them not to wait for the government, hears the treasurer Malam Shittu report the association's money, and agrees with young Bashiru that the association needs an overhaul; the young men cut fallen branches with axes, mix cement and sand and build a wall and a drain.
lessons.text:
A wata unguwa a Zaria, ruwan sama ya yi yawa a bana. Ruwan ya fara zaizayar hanyar da ta haɗa unguwar da kasuwa. Kowace safiya hanyar tana ƙara zama ƙarama, kuma ramukan da ke cikinta suna ƙara girma. Idan an yi ruwa, ƙasar hanyar tana da santsi sosai, har mutane suna faɗuwa. Wata tsohuwa ta faɗi saboda santsin ƙasa.

Hakimin unguwar, Alhaji Abdulmumini, ya kira taron maƙwabta a ƙofar gidansa ranar hutu. Maza da mata da matasa suka zo, suka zauna a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya.

Hakimin ya ce, "Kun ga yadda zaizayar ƙasa take cinye hanyarmu. Idan ba mu yi wani abu ba, a damina mai zuwa ruwa zai ɗauke hanyar duka, har ya kai gidajen da ke gefenta. Ina ba ku kashedi: kada mu jira gwamnati kawai. Zaman tare yana nufin mu taimaki juna."

Sai ya kira ma'ajin ƙungiyar unguwar, Malam Shittu, domin ya faɗa wa mutane kuɗin da ke hannunsa. Ma'ajin ya buɗe littafinsa ya ce, "Muna da naira dubu ɗari biyu a asusun ƙungiya. Wannan bai isa a sayi siminti da duwatsu ba."

Wani matashi, Bashiru, ya ɗaga hannu ya ce, "Alhaji, matsalar ba ta kuɗi kaɗai ba ce. Mutane da yawa ba sa biyan kuɗin kowane wata, saboda ba su san abin da ake yi da su ba. Ƙungiyarmu tana buƙatar garambawul."

Hakimin ya yarda da shi. Ya ce za a yi wa ƙungiyar garambawul: daga yanzu ma'aji zai karanta lissafin kuɗi a gaban kowa a kowane taro, kuma za a zaɓi sababbin shugabanni daga cikin matasa. Mutane suka yi tafi. Bayan taron kowa ya bayar da abin da zai iya, har kuɗin suka ninka.

Washegari matasa suka fito da gatari. Suka yanke rassan bishiyoyin da suka faɗi a kan hanya da gatari.

Sai ma'aji ya sayi siminti da yashi. Matasa suka cakuɗa siminti da yashi da ruwa a ƙasa. Wani tsoho ya ce musu, "Ku cakuɗa su sosai, in ba haka ba bangon ba zai yi ƙarfi ba." Suka gina ƙaramin bango a gefen hanya, suka haƙa magudanar ruwa domin ruwa ya bi ta cikinta, ba ta kan hanya ba.

Bayan mako biyu aikin ya ƙare. Da aka sake yin ruwa, ruwan ya bi magudanar, hanya ba ta yi santsi ba, kuma ba a sake ganin zaizaya ba. Hakimin ya gode wa kowa, ya ce, "Kashedin da na ba ku ya zama alheri. Abin da muka yi tare ya fi abin da kowa zai yi shi kaɗai."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa hakimin ya kira taro?
Ya kira taro saboda zaizayar ƙasa tana cinye hanyar unguwar.
Wane kashedi hakimin ya ba mutane?
Ya ba su kashedi cewa kada su jira gwamnati kawai.
Me ma'aji ya faɗa wa mutane?
Ya ce suna da naira dubu ɗari biyu a asusun ƙungiya, kuma bai isa ba.
Wane garambawul aka yi wa ƙungiyar?
Ma'aji zai karanta lissafin kuɗi a gaban kowa, kuma za a zaɓi sababbin shugabanni daga cikin matasa.
Me matasa suka yi da gatari?
Sun yanke rassan bishiyoyin da suka faɗi a kan hanya.
Me ya sa tsohon ya ce su cakuɗa siminti sosai?
Ya ce in ba haka ba bangon ba zai yi ƙarfi ba.

lessons.title: Shelar dawowar Sarki
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the emir is coming back from the pilgrimage; the Waziri, first among his close aides, sends his messenger Ɗayyabu to the town crier Malam Ɗangoggo, who proclaims the welcome at the market with his drum, and to the old title-holder Alhaji Lawali, known by the nickname Uban Gari; on Friday the town welcomes the emir at the gate and he prays to God the Most High for peace.
lessons.text:
Sarkin Katsina ya tafi aikin Hajji a Makka. Bayan makonni uku aka ji labari cewa zai dawo ranar Juma'a mai zuwa. Waziri, wanda shi ne babba a cikin muƙarraban Sarki, ya kira masinjansa, Ɗayyabu, zuwa fada.

Waziri ya ce, "Ɗayyabu, ka je wurin mai shela na kasuwa, Malam Ɗangoggo. Ka faɗa masa ya shelanta wa jama'a cewa Sarki zai dawo ranar Juma'a, kuma za a yi masa tarba a ƙofar gari da ƙarfe uku na yamma."

Masinjan ya hau babur ɗinsa ya tafi kasuwa. Malam Ɗangoggo tsoho ne mai murya mai ƙarfi. Ya ɗauki gangarsa, ya tsaya a tsakiyar kasuwa, ya buga ganga sau uku, sai ya yi shela: "Jama'a, ku saurara! Waziri ya ce in shelanta muku cewa Sarkinmu zai dawo daga Makka ranar Juma'a. Kowa ya fito domin tarbarsa a ƙofar gari!" Ya maimaita shelar a kowane ɓangare na kasuwa, sannan ya bi unguwanni yana yi.

Daga kasuwa masinjan ya wuce gidan wani tsohon basarake, Alhaji Lawali. Mutane suna kiran Alhaji Lawali da inkiyar "Uban Gari", domin yana taimakon kowa: yana sulhunta maƙwabta idan sun yi faɗa, yana ba marasa ƙarfi abinci, kuma ƙofar gidansa a buɗe take dare da rana. Yara da yawa ba su san sunansa na gaskiya ba; inkiyarsa kawai suka sani.

Basaraken ya ce wa masinja, "Ka gaya wa Waziri cewa zan kawo dawakai hamsin daga unguwarmu domin tarbar Sarki." Masinjan ya koma fada ya faɗa wa Waziri.

Ranar Juma'a jama'a suka cika hanya tun daga ƙofar gari har zuwa fada. Mata suna kallo daga ƙofofin gidaje, yara suna hawa bishiyoyi. Waziri da sauran muƙarraban Sarki suna tsaye a ƙofar gari cikin manyan riguna. Alhaji Lawali ya zo da dawakansa hamsin, kamar yadda ya ce.

Da motar Sarki ta iso, sai mutane suka yi ihu, "Allah ya ja zamanin Sarki!" Sarki ya fito ya hau doki, ya wuce cikin jama'a yana gaishe su. Da ya isa fada, ya yi wa jama'a jawabi. Ya ce, "Na gode muku saboda wannan tarba. A Makka na roƙi Allah Maɗaukakin Sarki ya ba ƙasarmu zaman lafiya da haɗin kai."

Bayan jawabin, Sarki ya kira Alhaji Lawali, ya ce, "Na ji cewa a garin nan ana kiranka da inkiyar Uban Gari. Inkiya ce da ta dace da kai." Kowa ya yi dariya, tsohon basaraken ya sunkuyar da kai. A ƙarshe Waziri ya yi addu'a: "Allah Maɗaukaki ya kiyaye mu, ya sa mu zauna lafiya da juna."

Tambayoyi:
Me Waziri ya ce wa masinjansa?
Ya ce ya je wurin mai shela ya faɗa masa ya shelanta cewa Sarki zai dawo ranar Juma'a.
Ina Malam Ɗangoggo ya yi shela?
Ya yi shela a tsakiyar kasuwa, sannan ya bi unguwanni.
Wace inkiya ake kiran Alhaji Lawali da ita?
Ana kiransa da inkiyar "Uban Gari".
Me ya sa ake kiransa da wannan inkiya?
Saboda yana taimakon kowa kuma yana sulhunta maƙwabta.
Me Sarki ya roƙi Allah a Makka?
Ya roƙi Allah Maɗaukakin Sarki ya ba ƙasarsu zaman lafiya da haɗin kai.

lessons.title: Magidanci a lokacin wahala
lessons.summary: In Kano, the family man Malam Ɗanmusa loses his factory job and falls into poverty with not a penny left; neighbours come to sympathise and his neighbour Hajiya Zuliyat lends him capital; he buys goods cheaply from the wholesalers, sells them at a moderate price in the neighbourhood, works hard, and a year later helps another family in the same way.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗanmusa magidanci ne a Kano. Yana da mata, Sadatu, da 'ya'ya biyar. Shekara goma sha biyu yana aiki a wani kamfani da ke yin takalma. Wata rana aka rufe kamfanin, aka sallami ma'aikata duka.

Da farko Ɗanmusa ya yi tunanin zai samu wani aiki da sauri. Amma watanni suka wuce babu aiki. Kuɗin da ya ajiye suka ƙare. Iyalinsa suka shiga tsiya: wani lokaci sukan ci abinci sau ɗaya a rana, kuma yaran ba sa zuwa makaranta saboda ba a biya kuɗin makarantarsu ba. Wata rana Sadatu ta tambaye shi kuɗin sayen gishiri, sai ya juya aljihunsa ya ce, "Wallahi ba ni da ko ƙwandala."

Maƙwabta suka ji labarin magidancin. Da yamma maza uku suka zo ƙofar gidansa, suka jajanta masa. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ce, "Malam, mun ji abin da ya same ka. Muna jajanta maka. Mun san ba ka da ko ƙwandala a yanzu, amma wannan tsiya ba laifinka ba ne. Kowa yana iya shiga irinta."

Washegari maƙwabciyarsu, Hajiya Zuliyat, wadda take sayar da kayan abinci, ta kira Sadatu da mijinta. Ta ce, "Ɗanmusa, kai magidanci ne mai gaskiya. Zan ba ka aron naira dubu hamsin. Ka sayi haja ka fara kasuwanci. Idan ka samu, sai ka biya ni."

Ɗanmusa ya gode mata ƙwarai. Ya tafi babbar kasuwa, inda manyan 'yan kasuwa suke sayar da haja da yawa. A can ya sayi taliya, sukari, sabulu da man girki a farashi mai rahusa, domin ya saya da yawa. Ya kawo hajar gida, Sadatu ta taimaka masa ya shirya ta a gaban ƙofarsu.

Bai sayar da hajarsa da tsada ba. Ya sa madaidaicin farashi, ba mai tsada ba, kuma ba mai rahusa har ya yi asara ba. Mata na unguwa suka ga cewa kayansa sun fi na kantin kan titi rahusa, suka fara saye a wurinsa. Ya ce wa Sadatu, "Madaidaicin farashi ya fi riba mai yawa, domin mutane za su dawo."

Ɗanmusa ya himmatu sosai. Yana tashi kafin asuba, yana zuwa kasuwa, yana dawowa ya buɗe kayansa har dare. Bayan wata shida ya biya Hajiya Zuliyat kuɗinta duka. Yaransa suka koma makaranta.

Bayan shekara guda, wani matashi a unguwar ya rasa aikinsa. Ɗanmusa ya je wurinsa ya jajanta masa, sannan ya ba shi haja ya sayar a kan bashi. Ya ce masa, "Ka himmatu, ka riƙe gaskiya. Haka maƙwabtana suka taimake ni lokacin da nake cikin tsiya."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa iyalin Ɗanmusa suka shiga tsiya?
Saboda an rufe kamfanin da yake aiki, kuma bai samu wani aiki ba.
Me Hajiya Zuliyat ta yi masa?
Ta ba shi aron naira dubu hamsin domin ya sayi haja.
A ina ya sayi haja da rahusa?
Ya saye ta a babbar kasuwa, inda manyan 'yan kasuwa suke sayarwa.
Wane farashi Ɗanmusa ya sa a kan kayansa?
Ya sa madaidaicin farashi, ba mai tsada ba.
Yaya Ɗanmusa ya himmatu?
Yana tashi kafin asuba, yana zuwa kasuwa, yana sayarwa har dare.
Me ya yi bayan shekara guda?
Ya jajanta wa wani matashi da ya rasa aiki, ya ba shi haja ya sayar.

lessons.title: Wasan unguwanni biyu
lessons.summary: In Bauchi, two neighbourhood football teams with an old rivalry meet in the final; a defender kicks the captain Nasir to provoke him and Nasir answers angrily, Kasim is rude to the referee Malam Audi and gets a card, the other team equalises, Nasir jumps, heads the ball in and lands but the goal is disallowed, the teams fight hard, Nasir's team wins on penalties, and the elders bring both teams to eat together.
lessons.text:
A Bauchi akwai wasu unguwanni biyu da suke maƙwabtaka da juna, kuma kowace tana da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa. Tun shekaru da yawa akwai gogayya tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu. Idan sun haɗu, sai unguwanni duka su fito kallo.

A bana ƙungiyoyin biyu suka kai wasan ƙarshe na gasar unguwanni. Kyaftin ɗin ƙungiya ta farko shi ne Nasir, ɗan shekara ashirin. Alƙalin wasa kuma shi ne Malam Audi, malamin wasanni a wata makarantar sakandare.

Kafin wasan, Malam Audi ya kira 'yan wasan duka, ya ce, "Gogayya tana da kyau idan a cikin wasa take. Amma kada a bar ta ta zama faɗa. Wanda ya yi faɗa zai fita daga fili."

Bayan minti goma, ƙungiyar Nasir ta ci ƙwallo ɗaya. Bayan haka wani ɗan wasa na ɗaya ƙungiyar ya shure Nasir a ƙafa, ba ƙwallo ba. Nasir ya faɗi ƙasa. Da ya tashi, ɗan wasan ya sake shure shi a hankali, yana dariya. Nasir ya gane cewa yana so ya harzuka shi ne, domin idan ya rama, alƙali zai kore shi.

Duk da haka Nasir ya ji haushi. Ya juya a fusace ya ce, "Me kake yi? Wannan ba wasa ba ne!" Abokinsa ya kama hannunsa ya ce, "Kada ka bari ya harzuka ka. Abin da yake so ke nan." Nasir ya yi shiru, ya koma matsayinsa.

Sai wani ɗan wasan ɗaya ƙungiyar, Kasim, ya je wurin alƙali a fusace, ya ɗaga masa murya, ya ce, "Kai ba ka san aikinka ba! Kana goyon bayansu ne!" Malam Audi ya ce, "Wannan fitsara ce. Ba za a yi mini fitsara a fili ba." Ya ba Kasim katin gargaɗi.

Bayan hutu, ɗaya ƙungiyar ta ci ƙwallo, ta farke. Mutanen unguwarsu suka yi ihu da murna saboda an farke. Yanzu ƙungiyoyin biyu suna da ci ɗaya da ɗaya. Sai aka yi ta gwabza. Kowace ƙungiya ta gwabza da ƙarfinta, amma babu wadda ta ƙara cin ƙwallo.

Ana saura minti uku, aka buga wa ƙungiyar Nasir ƙwallo daga kusurwa. Nasir ya yi tsalle sama, ya buga ƙwallon da kansa, sannan ya dira a ƙasa. Ƙwallon ya shiga raga! Amma alƙali ya ce an yi laifi kafin Nasir ya dira, don haka ba a ƙirga ƙwallon ba. Wasa ya ƙare ɗaya da ɗaya, aka buga fanariti, ƙungiyar Nasir ta ci.

Bayan wasan, dattawan unguwanni biyu suka kira 'yan wasan duka zuwa wurin cin abinci. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Kun gwabza kamar 'yan'uwa. Gogayya ta ƙare a fili; a nan duk ɗaya muke." Kasim ya je wurin Malam Audi ya ba shi haƙuri saboda fitsararsa.

Tambayoyi:
Wane abu ne yake tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu tun shekaru da yawa?
Akwai gogayya tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu.
Me ya sa ɗan wasan ya shure Nasir?
Yana so ya harzuka shi, domin alƙali ya kore shi.
Me Kasim ya yi wa alƙali?
Ya je wurinsa a fusace ya yi masa fitsara.
Yaya ɗaya ƙungiyar ta farke?
Ta ci ƙwallo bayan hutu.
Me ya faru bayan wasan?
Dattawa suka kira 'yan wasan duka suka ci abinci tare.

lessons.title: Krismeti a gidan Gyang
lessons.summary: In Jos, the Christian Gyang and the Muslim Malam Ɗantani have been close friends for thirty years; before Christmas Gyang's wife Kaneng decorates the house, cooks yam and has roasted meat bought from a Muslim butcher, steam rises from the pots, a cake topped with cherries comes from the bakery, the children sing, and Ɗantani's family comes to eat; at Sallah Gyang's family will go to Ɗantani's house.
lessons.text:
A Jos, Gyang da Malam Ɗantani abokai ne na kud da kud. Gyang Kirista ne, Ɗantani kuma Musulmi. Sun girma a unguwa ɗaya, sun yi makaranta tare, yanzu shekararsu talatin suna abota. Mutane suna cewa, "Duk inda ka ga Gyang, sahibinsa Ɗantani yana kusa."

Ana saura kwana biyu a yi bikin Krismeti, sai matar Gyang, Kaneng, ta fara shiri. Ta wanke gidan duka, sannan ta ƙawata falo da furanni da takardu masu launi. 'Ya'yanta suka taimaka mata suka ƙawata wata ƙaramar bishiya a ƙofar gida da fitilu. Gyang ya ce, "A bana mun ƙawata gidan fiye da kowace shekara."

Gyang ya kira sahibinsa a waya. Ya ce, "Ɗantani, ranar Krismeti kai da iyalinka za ku ci abinci a gidana, kamar kowace shekara." Ɗantani ya yi dariya ya ce, "Ai ba ka buƙatar gayyata. Abokin kud da kud ba ya jiran gayyata."

Ranar Krismeti da safe Kaneng ta dafa doya mai yawa a manyan tukwane. Tururi yana tashi daga tukwanen har ya cika ɗakin girki. Ta daka wani ɓangare na doyar ta yi sakwara, ta dafa miyar agushi. Wani ɓangare kuma ta soya shi. Tururin abinci ya fita har titi, yara suna wucewa suna jin ƙamshi.

Gyang ya san cewa Ɗantani da iyalinsa ba sa cin naman da ba Musulmi ne ya yanka ba. Saboda haka ya sayi gasasshen nama daga wurin wani mahauci Musulmi a kasuwa. Ya ce wa Kaneng, "Wannan gasasshen nama na kowa ne. Babu wanda zai ƙi ci a cikinmu."

Da rana, Gyang ya je gidan burodi ya karɓo babban kek. A kansa akwai jajayen 'ya'yan ceri. Yaran suka yi murna da ganin ceri, domin ba a cika samun ceri a kasuwannin Jos ba.

Da Ɗantani da matarsa da 'ya'yansu suka iso, yaran Gyang suka fito suka raira waƙoƙin Krismeti a ƙofar gida. 'Ya'yan Ɗantani ba su san waƙoƙin ba, amma suka yi tafi tare da su. Daga baya duk yaran suka raira wata waƙar Hausa da suka koya a makaranta.

Suka zauna duka suka ci doya da gasasshen nama, suka sha lemo. Bayan abinci aka yanka kek ɗin, kowane yaro ya samu ceri guda. Ɗantani ya ce wa sahibinsa, "Gyang, a Sallah mai zuwa ku ne baƙina. Matata za ta dafa muku abinci fiye da wannan." Gyang ya ce, "Mun yarda! Haka zaman tare yake."

Tambayoyi:
Wace irin abota ce tsakanin Gyang da Ɗantani?
Abokai ne na kud da kud tun shekara talatin.
Da me Kaneng ta ƙawata falo?
Ta ƙawata shi da furanni da takardu masu launi.
Me ya sa Gyang ya sayi gasasshen nama daga wurin mahauci Musulmi?
Saboda Ɗantani da iyalinsa ba sa cin naman da ba Musulmi ne ya yanka ba.
Daga ina tururi yake tashi?
Tururi yana tashi daga manyan tukwanen doya.
Me yake kan kek ɗin?
Akwai jajayen 'ya'yan ceri a kansa.
Me yaran Gyang suka yi da baƙi suka iso?
Suka raira waƙoƙin Krismeti a ƙofar gida.

lessons.title: Maƙarƙashiya a ƙungiyar 'yan kasuwa
lessons.summary: In a Kaduna market, the wealthy trader Alhaji Kabo wants to take control of the traders' association and spreads a fabricated story that its chairwoman Hajiya Yakudima has stolen its money; the dispute divides the market, she answers calmly and shows the books, her secretary Iyami brings a hidden recording that reveals the plot, and the members amend the association's rules.
lessons.text:
A wata babbar kasuwa a Kaduna, 'yan kasuwa suna da ƙungiya wadda take kula da tsaftar kasuwa da tsaro, kuma tana taimakon 'yan kasuwar da suka samu matsala. Shugabar ƙungiyar ita ce Hajiya Yakudima, wadda take sayar da atamfa tun shekaru ashirin.

A kasuwar akwai wani hamshaƙin attajiri, Alhaji Kabo. Yana da shaguna goma, kuma motocinsa suna kawo kaya daga Legas kowane mako. Duk da wannan arziki, hamshaƙin attajirin yana so ya riƙe akalar ƙungiyar, domin ya sa a yi abin da yake so a kasuwa.

Da zaɓe ya kusa, Alhaji Kabo ya fara yaɗa ƙage. Ya gaya wa 'yan kasuwa cewa Hajiya Yakudima ta saci kuɗin ƙungiya ta gina gida da su. Wasu suka yarda da ƙagensa, wasu suka ƙi. Sai dambarwa ta tashi a kasuwa. Masu goyon bayan Hajiya suna faɗa da masu goyon bayan Kabo, har wasu sun daina gaisawa. Dambarwar ta kai har gidajen mutane.

Hajiya Yakudima ba ta yi fushi ba. Ta kira taro, ta yi magana cikin tsanaki. Ta ce, "Na ji abin da ake faɗa a kaina. Ba zan yi zagi ba. Ga littattafan kuɗin ƙungiya; duk wanda yake so ya duba su." Wasu 'yan kasuwa suka duba littattafan cikin tsanaki, suka ga cewa babu kuɗin da ya ɓace.

Bayan kwana biyu, sakatariyar ƙungiyar, Iyami, ta zo wurin Hajiya da wayarta. Ta ce, "Hajiya, akwai wani ɓoyayyen abu a wannan waya. Lokacin da Alhaji Kabo yake magana da wasu mutanensa a shagonsa, wani yaro ya ɗauki muryarsu ba su sani ba."

A cikin ɓoyayyar maganar, an ji muryar Kabo yana cewa, "Mu ci gaba da yaɗa wannan labari har ranar zaɓe. Ko ba gaskiya ba ne, idan mutane suka yarda, akalar kasuwa za ta dawo hannuna." Wannan ita ce maƙarƙashiyar da aka ɓoye.

Hajiya ta saurari muryar cikin tsanaki, sannan ta kai ta wurin dattawan kasuwa. Dattawan suka kira taro, suka sa a ji muryar a gaban kowa. Mutane suka gane cewa labarin ƙage ne, kuma duk abin maƙarƙashiya ce. Hamshaƙin attajirin, Alhaji Kabo, ya ji kunya, ya janye daga takara.

Bayan zaɓe, 'yan ƙungiyar suka yi wa dokokinsu kwaskwarima. Sabuwar doka ta ce babu wanda zai riƙe shugabanci fiye da shekara huɗu, kuma za a karanta lissafin kuɗi a kowane wata. Hajiya Yakudima ta ce, "Wannan kwaskwarima za ta kare ƙungiyarmu daga kowace maƙarƙashiya."

Tambayoyi:
Me Alhaji Kabo yake so?
Yana so ya riƙe akalar ƙungiyar 'yan kasuwa.
Wane ƙage ya yaɗa?
Ya ce Hajiya Yakudima ta saci kuɗin ƙungiya.
Me ya faru bayan Kabo ya yaɗa ƙage?
Dambarwa ta tashi a kasuwa, masu goyon bayan ɓangarori biyu suna faɗa.
Yaya Hajiya Yakudima ta amsa?
Ta yi magana cikin tsanaki, ta nuna littattafan kuɗin ƙungiya.
Me Iyami ta kawo?
Ta kawo wata ɓoyayyar murya a wayarta, inda aka ji maƙarƙashiyar Kabo.
Wace kwaskwarima aka yi wa dokokin ƙungiyar?
Babu wanda zai riƙe shugabanci fiye da shekara huɗu, kuma za a karanta lissafin kuɗi kowane wata.

lessons.title: Rake a gefen kogi
lessons.summary: Near Gombe, Malam Liti grows sugarcane on two hectares by the river bank; one night the Fulani herder Ardo Hamman's cattle break in while his son Ahmadu chases a fox that took a chicken from their grass hut; in the morning crows sit on the broken cane, which will rot; the Ardo rides over with two other riders, apologises and pays, and the two men agree on a cattle path away from the farm.
lessons.text:
Kusa da Gombe, Malam Liti yana da gonar rake mai girman hekta biyu. Gonar tana gefen kogi, a kan gacin ruwa, domin rake yana son ruwa sosai.

Ba nisa da gonar akwai wani Bafulatani makiyayi, Ardo Hamman, da iyalinsa. Suna zaune a cikin bukkoki uku da aka yi da ciyawa. Shanunsu suna kiwo a daji, kuma da yamma suna zuwa gacin kogi suna shan ruwa.

Wata dare wata yanyawa ta shigo bukkar kaji ta Ardo, ta ɗauki kaza. Ɗansa Ahmadu, ɗan shekara goma sha biyar, ya ji kukan kajin, ya tashi ya bi yanyawar da sanda cikin duhu. Lokacin da yake bin yanyawar, ya manta ya rufe wurin shanu. Shanu suka fita, suka bi gacin kogi har suka shiga gonar rake.

Da safe Malam Liti ya zo gona, sai ya ga abin da ya faru. Shanu sun karya rake da yawa, sun cinye wasu. Hankaka da yawa suna zaune a kan raken da ya karye, suna tsotsar ruwansa. Liti ya kori hankakan, amma sun koma bayan ɗan lokaci. Ya ƙirga, ya ga kusan rabin hekta ta lalace. Ya san cewa idan ba a sayar da raken da ya karye da sauri ba, zai ruɓe a ƙasa cikin kwana uku.

Liti ya ji haushi ƙwarai, amma bai je bukkar Ardo da faɗa ba. Ya tafi gidan hakimin ƙauye ya faɗa masa.

Bayan awa ɗaya aka ga mahaya uku a kan dawakai suna zuwa. Mahayin farko shi ne Ardo Hamman, sauran mahaya biyu kuma 'yan'uwansa ne. Ardo ya sauka daga doki, ya gaishe da Liti, ya ce, "Malam, na ji abin da shanuna suka yi. Laifin namu ne. Zan biya ka abin da ya lalace."

Hakimin ya tambayi Liti nawa ne kuɗin raken da ya lalace. Suka yi lissafi tare, suka yarda a kan naira dubu ɗari. Ardo ya biya rabin kuɗin a nan take, ya ce zai biya sauran bayan ya sayar da sa ɗaya a kasuwa. Sannan Ahmadu da 'yan'uwansa suka taimaka wa Liti suka tara raken da ya karye kafin ya ruɓe, aka kai shi kasuwa aka sayar. Raken da ya riga ya ruɓe kuwa, suka ba shanu.

Sai hakimin ya ce, "Kun zauna tare shekaru da yawa. Bari mu nemi hanyar da ba za a sake samun irin wannan matsala ba." Suka yarda cewa shanu za su riƙa bin wata hanya ta daban zuwa gacin kogi, nesa da gonar rake.

Kafin ya hau dokinsa, Ardo ya ce wa Liti, "Idan ka gama girbi, zan kawo maka takin shanu domin gonarka." Liti ya yi murmushi ya ce, "Na gode. Haka maƙwabta suke yi."

Tambayoyi:
Ina gonar Malam Liti take?
Tana gefen kogi, a kan gacin ruwa, kusa da Gombe.
A ina Ardo Hamman da iyalinsa suke zaune?
Suna zaune a cikin bukkoki uku da aka yi da ciyawa.
Me ya sa Ahmadu ya manta ya rufe wurin shanu?
Saboda yana bin yanyawar da ta ɗauki kaza.
Me hankaka suke yi a gonar?
Suna zaune a kan raken da ya karye, suna tsotsar ruwansa.
Wane ne mahayin farko?
Mahayin farko shi ne Ardo Hamman.

lessons.title: Almajirin da ya faɗi a ƙofa
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the almajiri boy Sufyan, dressed in a torn piece of cloth, falls dizzy at Hajiya Halimatu's door while begging; she gives him water and food, sees lice in his hair, and her husband Malam Atiku, a barber, shaves his head with a razor; the clinic finds hunger and malaria and gives medicine for his healing, he makes his ablution at their tap before prayer, and the women of the street do their utmost to feed the almajirai in turns.
lessons.text:
A Sokoto akwai almajirai da yawa da suke zuwa ƙofofin gidaje suna neman abinci. Wata rana da rana, wani ƙaramin almajiri, Sufyan, ɗan shekara takwas, ya zo ƙofar gidan Hajiya Halimatu. Kayansa sun tsufa, kuma a jikinsa akwai wani tsohon kyalle da ya yage. Yana riƙe da kwanonsa, yana cewa, "Allah ya ba ku lada, ku taimake ni."

Kafin Hajiya Halimatu ta fito, sai jiri ya kama yaron. Ya ji duniya tana juyawa, ya zauna a ƙasa, sannan ya kwanta. Hajiya ta fito da sauri, ta ga yaron a kwance. Ta kawo ruwa ta ba shi ya sha, ta tambaye shi, "Me ke damunka?" Ya ce, "Ina jin jiri. Tun jiya ban ci abinci ba."

Ta shigar da shi gida, ta ba shi abinci da madara. Yayin da yake ci, sai ta ga wasu ƙananan ƙwari suna tafiya a cikin gashin kansa. Kwarkwata ce! Ta kuma ga wurare da dama a kansa inda ya yi ta sosa saboda kwarkwata.

Mijinta, Malam Atiku, wanzami ne. Da ya dawo daga kasuwa, ta faɗa masa. Ya ce, "Kwarkwata ba ta da wuya. Za mu aske gashin duka." Ya fito da sabuwar reza, domin ba ya amfani da reza ɗaya ga mutane biyu. Ya aske kan yaron a hankali da reza, sannan Hajiya ta wanke masa kai da sabulu da ruwan ɗumi. Ta ƙone tsohon kyallen, ta ba shi wata riga mai tsabta ta ɗanta.

Washegari ta kai Sufyan asibitin unguwa. Likita ya gwada shi ya ce, "Jirin da yake ji yana da dalili biyu: yunwa da zazzaɓin cizon sauro. Idan ya sha wannan magani kuma yana cin abinci sosai, zai samu waraka cikin mako ɗaya." Hajiya ta sayi maganin.

Da suka dawo, aka kira sallar La'asar. Sufyan ya je famfon gidan ya yi alwala. Malam Atiku ya ga yadda ya yi alwalar da kyau, ya ce, "Malaminka ya koya maka sosai." Sannan suka tafi masallaci tare.

Kowace rana Sufyan yana zuwa gidan Hajiya ya ci abinci, ya sha maganinsa. Bayan kwana bakwai ya samu cikakkiyar waraka. Jirin ya tafi, kwarkwatar ma ta ƙare.

Hajiya Halimatu ta ce wa maƙwabtanta, "Wannan yaron ya taɓa mini zuci. Akwai yara kamarsa da yawa a unguwarmu. Bari mu yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinmu mu taimake su." Mata goma suka yarda cewa kowacce za ta ciyar da almajirai a rana ɗaya ta mako. Suka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinsu, kuma suka ga cewa abin da kowacce ta bayar kaɗan ne, amma tare ya isa. Wata mata ta ce, "Duk abin da aka yi da tsarki a zuci, Allah yana gani."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya kama Sufyan a ƙofar gidan Hajiya Halimatu?
Jiri ya kama shi saboda tun jiya bai ci abinci ba.
Me Hajiya ta gani a gashin kansa?
Ta ga kwarkwata.
Me Malam Atiku ya yi da reza?
Ya aske kan yaron a hankali da sabuwar reza.
Me likita ya ce game da waraka?
Ya ce idan ya sha magani kuma yana cin abinci, zai samu waraka cikin mako ɗaya.
Me matan unguwar suka yi?
Suka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinsu, kowacce tana ciyar da almajirai a rana ɗaya ta mako.

lessons.title: Kanar da 'yan banga
lessons.summary: In a Kaduna neighbourhood, burglars act with impunity at night; the retired colonel Kanar Abdussalam gathers the neighbours in one place, among them his Yoruba neighbour Chief Adewale, and they choose upright young men led by Jibril as a vigilante group and fit a strong, durable gate; one night the thieves come down from the hill with their loot, are caught and handed to the police, and the loot is returned to its owners.
lessons.text:
A wata unguwa a Kaduna, ɓarayi sun dame mutane. Kusan kowane mako suna shiga gida ɗaya da dare, suna ɗaukar talabijin, wayoyi da kuɗi. 'Yan sanda suna nesa, kuma ɓarayin suna cin karensu babu babbaka, domin babu wanda yake hana su.

A unguwar akwai wani tsohon soja, Kanar Abdussalam. Ya yi shekara talatin a aikin soja kafin ya yi ritaya. Wata rana ya ce, "Ba za mu bar ɓarayi suna cin karensu babu babbaka ba. Dole mu taru gu ɗaya mu yi magana."

Ranar Lahadi maƙwabta suka taru gu ɗaya a filin masallaci. Daga cikinsu akwai wani Bayarabe, Cif Adewale, wanda ya yi shekara ashirin yana zaune a unguwar. Mutane suna kiransa "Cif" saboda sarautar da yake da ita a garinsu. Shi ma ɓarayi sun shiga gidansa watan jiya.

Kanar ya ce, "Mu kafa ƙungiyar 'yan banga. Amma kada mu ɗauki kowa. Muna so nagartattun matasa, waɗanda kowa ya san halinsu, ba masu shan ƙwaya ko faɗa ba." Cif Adewale ya ce, "Na yarda da Kanar. Idan ba nagartattun mutane ba ne, za su zama ɓarayi su ma." Aka zaɓi matasa goma sha biyu, shugabansu kuma wani matashi mai suna Jibril, wanda kowa ya san shi da gaskiya.

Cif Adewale ya ce zai biya kuɗin ƙofa babba a hanyar shiga unguwar. Kanar ya ce, "Mu sayi ƙofar ƙarfe mai karko, ba ta katako ba. Ƙofar da ba ta da karko ba za ta daɗe ba." Aka kafa ƙofar ƙarfe mai karko, ana rufe ta da ƙarfe goma na dare.

Bayan mako uku, wata dare Jibril da abokansa suna tsaron gefen dutse da ke bayan unguwa. Da misalin ƙarfe biyu na dare, suka ga mutane uku suna gangarowa daga dutsen, suna ɗauke da manyan buhuna. Suna gangarowa a hankali, domin suna tunanin babu mai ganinsu.

Jibril ya buga wa Kanar waya. Kanar ya ce, "Kada ku taɓa su da makami. Ku kewaye su kawai." Matasan suka kewaye su, suka kama su ba tare da an ji wa kowa rauni ba. A cikin buhunan suka samu ganimar da ɓarayin suka tara: wayoyi takwas, talabijin biyu da agogo. Ashe sun shiga wani gida a unguwar da ke bayan dutse, sun ɗauko ganimar suna gangarowa zuwa kasuwa.

Da safe aka kai ɓarayin ofishin 'yan sanda. 'Yan sanda suka mayar da ganimar ga masu ita. Wata tsohuwa da aka sace wayarta ta ce, "Allah ya saka wa waɗannan nagartattun matasa da alheri." Kanar Abdussalam ya ce, "Tsaron unguwa ba aikin mutum ɗaya ba ne. Mun yi nasara saboda mun taru gu ɗaya."

Tambayoyi:
Me ɓarayi suke yi a unguwar?
Suna shiga gidaje da dare suna cin karensu babu babbaka.
Me ya sa ake kiran Adewale "Cif"?
Saboda sarautar da yake da ita a garinsu.
Wane irin matasa Kanar yake so a ƙungiyar 'yan banga?
Yana so nagartattun matasa waɗanda kowa ya san halinsu.
Me ya sa Kanar ya ce a sayi ƙofar ƙarfe?
Saboda ƙofar ƙarfe tana da karko fiye da ta katako.
Me aka samu a cikin buhunan ɓarayin?
An samu ganimar da suka tara: wayoyi, talabijin da agogo.

lessons.title: Muhawarar makaranta
lessons.summary: In an Abuja secondary school, Rabiya and Yerima debate whether modern technology divides society: she speaks of families eating pizza alone in front of phones under the fan, of robots taking workers' jobs by one estimate, and of foreign films that show lesbianism and homosexuality which Nigerian law forbids; he answers with astronomy that helps fix the start of Ramadan, an app that teaches the vowels to old women, and calls to relatives abroad; the judge Mrs. Ngozi Okafor asks the audience to guess the winner.
lessons.text:
A wata makarantar sakandare a Abuja, ɗalibai suna yin muhawara kowace Alhamis. A wannan mako batun muhawarar shi ne: "Fasahar zamani tana raba kan al'umma." Rabiya za ta goyi bayan batun, Yerima kuma zai yi adawa da shi. Alƙaliyar muhawarar ita ce malamarsu, Misis Ngozi Okafor.

Rabiya ta fara. Ta ce, "A da, iyali suna cin abinci tare a tabarma ɗaya, suna hira. Yau a birane, uwa tana kallon waya, uba yana kallon talabijin, yara kuma suna cin fizza a ɗakunansu a ƙarƙashin fanka, babu mai magana da wani. Ko abincin ma ya canja: maimakon tuwo, ana kiran mota ta kawo fizza."

Ta ci gaba: "Na biyu, robot yana karɓar aikin mutane. A wasu ƙasashe, robot ne yake haɗa motoci a kamfani. Wani ƙiyasi ya nuna cewa nan da shekara goma, mutane miliyoyi a duniya za su rasa aikinsu saboda injuna. Idan mutum ba shi da aiki, zaman lafiya a gida da unguwa zai yi wuya."

"Na uku," in ji Rabiya, "intanet yana kawo mana finafinai da al'adun da ba namu ba. A wasu ƙasashe dokar ƙasa ta yarda da luwaɗi da madigo, amma dokar Najeriya ta hana su. Iyaye da yawa suna tsoron cewa yara za su ga irin waɗannan abubuwa a waya ba tare da sun sani ba."

Sai Yerima ya tashi. Ya ce, "Na gode wa Rabiya, amma ina ganin fasaha tana haɗa kanmu ne. Misali, ilimin falaki. Kakanninmu malamai sun yi amfani da ilimin falaki don sanin lokacin sallah da watanni. Yau masana falaki suna amfani da na'urori su faɗi ranar da za a ga wata, sai mutane su san lokacin azumi tare."

Ya ci gaba: "Kakata ba ta iya karatu ba. Amma a bara yayana ya saka mata wata manhaja a waya mai koyar da karatun Hausa. Manhajar tana farawa da wasali: tana nuna kowane wasali tana karanta shi. Yanzu kakata tana karanta saƙonni da kanta. Ka ga, fasaha ce ta haɗa ta da jikokinta."

"A ƙarshe," in ji Yerima, "ɗan'uwana yana karatu a ƙasar waje. Kowace Juma'a muna ganinsa a waya, muna magana da shi." Game da ƙiyasin aikin injuna, ya ce, "Fanka da robot duk mutane ne suke gyara su. Za a samu sababbin ayyuka." Game da finafinai masu nuna madigo, ya ce iyaye za su iya kulle irin waɗannan abubuwa a wayoyin yara.

Bayan muhawarar, Misis Okafor ta ce, "Ba zan faɗa muku wanda ya ci yanzu ba. Bari kowa ya canka. Wanda ya canka daidai zai samu kyautar littafi." Mafi yawansu suka canka Yerima, kuma shi ne ya ci da maki ɗaya kawai.

Tambayoyi:
Me Rabiya ta ce game da fizza?
Ta ce yara suna cin fizza a ɗakunansu a ƙarƙashin fanka, babu mai magana da wani.
Me ƙiyasin da Rabiya ta ambata ya nuna?
Ya nuna cewa mutane miliyoyi za su rasa aikinsu saboda injuna nan da shekara goma.
Me manhajar kakar Yerima take koyarwa da farko?
Tana farawa da wasali, tana nuna kowane wasali tana karanta shi.
Me Misis Okafor ta ce ɗalibai su yi?
Ta ce kowa ya canka wanda ya ci muhawarar.
